mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'::plan_status_enum LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND status = 'PAUSED'::plan_status_enum ORDER BY status_changed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND status = 'SCHEDULED'::plan_status_enum AND start_date <= #{date} ORDER BY start_date, created_at LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(w.completed_at) FROM workouts w WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId}::uuid
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id = #{planId}::uuid AND user_id = #{userId}::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND status != 'REPLACED'::workout_status_enum ORDER BY day_number

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, p.created_at AS prescription_created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url, e.coach_cue AS exercise_coach_cue, e.coach_cue_en AS exercise_coach_cue_en, e.muscle_group AS exercise_muscle_group FROM prescriptions p JOIN workouts w ON w.id = p.workout_id JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE w.plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND w.status != 'REPLACED'::workout_status_enum AND p.removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY w.day_number, p.sequence
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND day_number = #{dayNumber} AND status != 'REPLACED'::workout_status_enum LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND plan_id = #{planId}::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, p.created_at AS prescription_created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url, e.coach_cue AS exercise_coach_cue, e.coach_cue_en AS exercise_coach_cue_en, e.muscle_group AS exercise_muscle_group FROM prescriptions p JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid AND p.removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.sequence

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, p.created_at AS prescription_created_at, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url, e.coach_cue AS exercise_coach_cue, e.coach_cue_en AS exercise_coach_cue_en, e.muscle_group AS exercise_muscle_group FROM prescriptions p JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid AND p.exercise_id = #{exerciseId} AND p.removed_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT e.* FROM exercises e JOIN exercises original ON original.id = #{exerciseId} WHERE e.id != original.id AND LOWER(e.body_part) != LOWER(#{hurtBodyPart}) AND (e.equipment = original.equipment OR e.equipment = 'body weight') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prescriptions current_p WHERE current_p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid AND current_p.exercise_id = e.id AND current_p.removed_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exercise_feedbacks ef JOIN workouts fw ON fw.id = ef.workout_id JOIN plans fp ON fp.id = fw.plan_id JOIN exercises hurt_exercise ON hurt_exercise.id = ef.exercise_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND ef.filter_until >= CURRENT_DATE AND (ef.exercise_id = e.id OR hurt_exercise.muscle_group = e.muscle_group) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.target = original.target THEN 0 WHEN e.muscle_group = original.muscle_group THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, e.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workouts SET completed_at = #{completedAt}, status = 'COMPLETED'::workout_status_enum, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE plans SET status = 'SUPERSEDED'::plan_status_enum, status_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'::plan_status_enum AND version = #{version}

UPDATE plans SET status = #{newStatus}::plan_status_enum, status_changed_at = #{changedAt}, updated_at = #{changedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND status = #{expectedStatus}::plan_status_enum AND version = #{version}

UPDATE plans SET version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND status = #{expectedStatus}::plan_status_enum AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE workouts SET status = 'REPLACED'::workout_status_enum, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND plan_id = #{planId}::uuid AND status = 'READY'::workout_status_enum AND completed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans ( id, user_id, profile_snapshot, status, start_date, end_date, parent_plan_id, version, status_changed_at ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{userId}::uuid, #{profileSnapshot, typeHandler=com.fitness.config.JsonbTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{status}::plan_status_enum, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{parentPlanId}::uuid, #{version}, #{statusChangedAt} )

INSERT INTO workouts ( id, owner_user_id, plan_id, replaced_workout_id, day_number, focus, source, status ) VALUES (#{id}::uuid, #{ownerUserId}::uuid, #{planId}::uuid, #{replacedWorkoutId}::uuid, #{dayNumber}, #{focus}::training_day_focus_enum, #{source}::workout_source_enum, #{status}::workout_status_enum)

INSERT INTO prescriptions ( id, workout_id, exercise_id, sequence, sets, reps, load, load_type, rpe ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{workoutId}::uuid, #{exerciseId}, #{sequence}, #{sets}, #{reps}, #{load}, #{loadType}::load_type_enum, #{rpe} )
